verdict.rationale: New Relic collects all three signals in one platform: APM agents across seven languages, infrastructure monitoring, OpenTelemetry ingest and built-in log management. APM agents attach metadata to logs to provide 'logs in context' alongside events, errors and traces, and NRQL queries span all of this data. A community user confirms the value of 'having everything in one dashboard', though another reported a logging-agent bug that silently lost logs, which tempers confidence. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of distributed tracing and of the trace-to-metric pivot workflow, and independent hands-on corroboration of cross-signal pivoting.
